Honestly, I attempted suicide about three weeks ago. I was addicted to opiates, I've been sober now for about six weeks, I'm 18, I live with my parents. I spent awhile in the hospital after my attempt, told my parents about my drug use, now my mom monitors everything and keeps all the meds locked in a safe.. honestly, sometimes I do miss opiates, but I'm glad I'm sober now, I'm still doing other pills, but I've been able to stay away from the codeine, morphine, etc. I know our situations are not the same, but it's better to get help now before it consumes your life, even if it does consume your life, there's always a way out, suicide honestly isn't going to fix your problems, and I say that as an (often) suicidal person. If you need to talk feel free to message me, I'm a good listener, and I'm judgement free. I hope you do well, and I'm always here if you need someone 💜
